visual_review.findings: Both sides retain sponsor placement, Italian flags and readable major artwork. The top view retains nose number, Shell design and upper body artwork. Removing the original decal surface offset places their colors directly on the retained curved chassis surface. The retained clear coat and carbon shading now cover the printed colors; no independent decal geometry or relief remains.

design_coverage_validation.color_space: sRGB encoded texture values with linear material constants converted to sRGB
design_coverage_validation.criteria: All 38 designs project onto retained geometry with median color error under 0.2 and more than half their sampled opaque interiors within 0.2 per channel. Edge filtering and the removal of the original decal surface offset can change individual samples.

vertical_shell_separation_meters.construction: Upper skin translated vertically by 1.5 millimeters; normal thickness varies with surface slope
